Current test-build status

Automatic cloud-account deletion is paused with cloud sharing. A disabled Delete account button, signing out, uninstalling Bounty or sending a message is not confirmation that an account has been deleted. An existing interrupted deletion request stays saved for later continuation.

This page is a draft request route for owner review. The support inbox and an operator process for verified Firebase and RevenueCat removal must be confirmed before this page is published or used to claim a working deletion service.

How to request account or data deletion

Email kunal26das@gmail.com with the subject Bounty account deletion or Bounty data request. State whether you want the Bounty account removed, a copy of data, or help removing particular data. Include the sign-in provider, the account email shown in Bounty if available, and your platform. You do not need to create another Bounty account to send a request.

Do not send a password, one-time code, ID token, full card details or private ledger. Ownership needs to be verified before account changes; the operator should use a proportionate verified process and explain any additional information required. A request is complete only after the operator confirms the result and any data retained. No completion time is promised by this draft.

Save a ledger export and original receipt files you need before removal. Deleting an account may end access to that account's records and Pro identity. Manage renewal with your storefront first: deleting a Bounty account does not cancel an auto-renewing subscription.

What the prepared cloud cleanup removes and retains

When enabled and completed, the prepared cloud cleanup removes the Bounty sign-in account, cloud profile and memberships, the account's comments and uploaded receipt files. A group with no remaining members is removed. Shared groups with other members retain amounts, titles, notes, financial history and participant identifiers, while the removed participant is labelled Former member and its linked account and email fields are removed.

Retained titles, notes, identifiers and financial history may still contain personal information entered by users. This is not guaranteed anonymization or deletion of every occurrence of a person's information. The owner must confirm any justified retention, its duration and how a request to remove embedded personal data will be handled before launch.

The prepared cloud workflow does not automatically erase exported files, copies held by other participants, offline caches on other devices, or provider-held billing records. RevenueCat and storefront data need a separately verified handling process; this app's cloud deletion code does not prove those records were removed.

Local and browser records

Local and Demo workspaces are separate from a signed-in account. Signing out or deleting a cloud account does not remove them. To remove local app or browser records, use your device's app-data or browser site-data controls after saving anything you need. iOS Keychain can retain a sign-in credential independently of ledger files; sign out before removing the app when possible.

Files you exported or shared are separate copies. Remove those from their saved locations or ask their recipients where appropriate. Account deletion cannot remotely erase a copy you or another participant already exported.

Prepare a deletion request email ↗

Opens your email app. Review the message before sending; no request is submitted by this page. Sending a message does not confirm deletion or cancel a subscription.
